title: S-adenosylmethionine Synthesis and Stress Granule Formation in Cancer Cells
summary: This cluster revolves around the synthesis of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) and its involvement in cancer cells. SAM is synthesized by Sam1 and Sam2, and is a product of S-adenosylhomocysteine. It is also involved in methionine metabolism, which is affected by cancer. Stress granules, which are involved in cellular starvation and Ded1, are assembled by Sam1. The presence of SAM affects Sam1, which in turn affects glucose and cycloheximide. The relationship between SAM and cancer is further supported by its involvement in Liver Health, which is related to Cancer.
